concept: Rugged garage-floor industrial palette for Lovells Discount Tire: a near-black charcoal ink reads like tire rubber and stamped steel, paired with a high-visibility safety-yellow accent and a deep amber primary that anchors buttons and CTAs with white labels. A steel-blue secondary adds dependable, technical contrast against crisp white and cool light-gray surfaces. High-contrast, bold, and built to look as tough and reliable as the shop.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA targets verified. Ink #15191E on bg #FFFFFF = 17.65:1 (>=7); on surface 16.29:1; on surface-alt 14.73:1. Ink-soft #535C66 on bg = 6.79:1 (>=4.5); on surface 6.27:1. White on primary amber #A66400 = 4.73:1 (>=4.5); white on primary-dark #7A4A00 = 7.48:1. White on steel-blue secondary #2C5F8A = 6.75:1. Primary on bg = 4.73:1 (>=3). Accent safety-yellow #F5B301 is a non-text highlight (1.85:1 on white); use ink on accent (9.52:1) for any text on yellow fills/badges.
